question: What IPv6 or dual-stack exposure contract should Gateway LAN/custom binds support?
rationale: The useful fix changes who can reach a non-loopback Gateway listener, and code alone cannot decide whether existing lan should broaden exposure or whether IPv6 should be an explicit operator opt-in.

options.title: Add an explicit dual-stack contract
options.body: Introduce or document a clear IPv6/dual-stack bind mode or custom-host rule with auth/origin/firewall warnings and upgrade tests before changing current lan behavior.

options.title: Make lan dual-stack by default
options.body: Change existing lan semantics to include IPv6 and accept the broader exposure/OS-compatibility risk as intentional product policy.

options.title: Keep IPv4-only core behavior
options.body: Leave native Gateway bind IPv4-only and document the IPv4 sidecar/proxy workaround for IPv6-only hosts.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit dual-stack contract
recommendation.body: Introduce or document a clear IPv6/dual-stack bind mode or custom-host rule with auth/origin/firewall warnings and upgrade tests before changing current lan behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Gateway bind/listen history and security-adjacent startup behavior route most strongly through this contributor.
